question: Berapa win rate tiap produk khusus pelanggan segmen Enterprise?
sql: SELECT product, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 2) AS win_rate FROM deals AS d FINAL ARRAY JOIN d.products_involved AS product INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.segment = 'Enterprise' GROUP BY product ORDER BY win_rate DESC

question: Rekap omset kuartal ini per tag pelanggan.
sql: SELECT tag, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id ARRAY JOIN c.tags AS tag WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfQuarter(today()) GROUP BY tag ORDER BY total_omset DESC

question: Untuk setiap wilayah pelanggan, produk apa yang omsetnya paling tinggi?
sql: SELECT region_omset.region, argMax(region_omset.product, region_omset.total_omset) AS produk_teratas, max(region_omset.total_omset) AS omset_tertinggi FROM (SELECT c.attributes['region'] AS region, product, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL ARRAY JOIN d.products_involved AS product INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY region, product) AS region_omset GROUP BY region_omset.region ORDER BY region_omset.region

question: Cari pelanggan yang punya deal won berisi Security-Plus tapi tidak punya tag high-value.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE NOT has(c.tags, 'high-value') AND c.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND has(d.products_involved, 'Security-Plus'))

question: Siapa sales yang menjual paling banyak jenis produk berbeda di deal won? Tampilkan 10 teratas.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, uniqExact(product) AS jumlah_jenis_produk FROM deals AS d FINAL ARRAY JOIN d.products_involved AS product INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY jumlah_jenis_produk DESC LIMIT 10

question: Hitung forecast per produk untuk tiap tim sales.
sql: SELECT r.team, product, sum(d.value * d.probability / 100) AS forecast FROM deals AS d FINAL ARRAY JOIN d.products_involved AS product INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') GROUP BY r.team, product ORDER BY r.team, forecast DESC

question: Ranking produk berdasarkan omset di masing-masing wilayah sales.
sql: SELECT r.region, product, sum(d.value) AS total_omset, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC) AS peringkat FROM deals AS d FINAL ARRAY JOIN d.products_involved AS product INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.region, product ORDER BY r.region, peringkat

question: list customer Gold yg masih punya tiket urgent belum selesai
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.attributes['tier'] = 'Gold' AND c.customer_id IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority = 'urgent' AND t.status IN ('open','in_progress'))

question: Berapa persen omset tahun ini yang berasal dari deal yang melibatkan Analytics-Suite?
sql: SELECT round(sumIf(d.value, has(d.products_involved, 'Analytics-Suite')) / sum(d.value), 2) AS persen_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today())

question: Produk mana yang jumlah deal lost-nya lebih banyak dari deal won?
sql: SELECT product, countIf(d.stage = 'won') AS jumlah_won, countIf(d.stage = 'lost') AS jumlah_lost FROM deals AS d FINAL ARRAY JOIN d.products_involved AS product GROUP BY product HAVING jumlah_lost > jumlah_won

question: Bandingkan rata-rata nilai deal won yang multi-produk dengan yang cuma satu produk.
sql: SELECT round(avgIf(d.value, length(d.products_involved) > 1), 2) AS rata_rata_multi_produk, round(avgIf(d.value, length(d.products_involved) = 1), 2) AS rata_rata_satu_produk FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won'

question: Untuk tiap tag pelanggan, berapa rata-rata waktu penyelesaian tiket yang sudah resolved?
sql: SELECT tag, round(avg(t.resolution_time_hours), 2) AS rata_rata_jam FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id ARRAY JOIN c.tags AS tag WHERE t.status = 'resolved' GROUP BY tag ORDER BY rata_rata_jam DESC

question: Industri mana yang win rate-nya tertinggi, hanya untuk industri dengan minimal 30 deal closed?
sql: SELECT c.attributes['industry'] AS industry, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 2) AS win_rate FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY industry HAVING countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')) >= 30 ORDER BY win_rate DESC LIMIT 1

question: Cari pelanggan yang punya deal won tapi belum pernah beli Cloud-Storage-Pro.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won') AND c.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND has(d.products_involved, 'Cloud-Storage-Pro'))

question: Bandingkan omset bulan ini dan bulan lalu untuk setiap produk.
sql: SELECT product, sumIf(d.value, d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(today())) AS omset_bulan_ini, sumIf(d.value, d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(subtractMonths(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfMonth(today())) AS omset_bulan_lalu FROM deals AS d FINAL ARRAY JOIN d.products_involved AS product WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(subtractMonths(today(), 1)) GROUP BY product ORDER BY product

question: Produk apa saja yang sudah terjual ke pelanggan di keempat wilayah (APAC, EMEA, NA, LATAM)?
sql: SELECT product FROM deals AS d FINAL ARRAY JOIN d.products_involved AS product INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND c.attributes['region'] IN ('APAC','EMEA','NA','LATAM') GROUP BY product HAVING uniqExact(c.attributes['region']) = 4

question: Top 3 tag pelanggan dengan omset terbesar tahun ini.
sql: SELECT tag, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id ARRAY JOIN c.tags AS tag WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY tag ORDER BY total_omset DESC LIMIT 3

question: Jumlah aktivitas dengan sentimen positif per tag pelanggan dalam 90 hari terakhir.
sql: SELECT tag, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id ARRAY JOIN c.tags AS tag WHERE a.sentiment = 'positive' AND a.timestamp >= subtractDays(now(), 90) GROUP BY tag ORDER BY jumlah_aktivitas DESC

question: Tampilkan running total omset bulanan tahun ini dari deal yang melibatkan Security-Plus.
sql: SELECT bulanan.bulan, bulanan.total_omset, sum(bulanan.total_omset) OVER (ORDER BY bulanan.bulan) AS running_total FROM (SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND has(d.products_involved, 'Security-Plus') AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan) AS bulanan ORDER BY bulanan.bulan

question: Per tier, hitung jumlah pelanggan aktif, jumlah churn, dan churn rate-nya.
sql: SELECT c.attributes['tier'] AS tier, countIf(c.status = 'active') AS jumlah_aktif, countIf(c.status = 'churned') AS jumlah_churn, round(countIf(c.status = 'churned') / count(), 2) AS churn_rate FROM customers AS c FINAL GROUP BY tier ORDER BY churn_rate DESC

question: Siapa sales yang paling banyak menang deal dengan pelanggan di luar wilayah sales-nya sendiri?
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, count() AS jumlah_deal FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND c.attributes['region'] != r.region GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY jumlah_deal DESC LIMIT 1

question: 10 pelanggan yang paling banyak membeli jenis produk berbeda dari deal won.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, uniqExact(product) AS jumlah_jenis_produk FROM deals AS d FINAL ARRAY JOIN d.products_involved AS product INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY jumlah_jenis_produk DESC LIMIT 10

question: Produk apa yang paling sering dibundel bareng API-Gateway?
sql: SELECT product, count() AS jumlah_deal FROM deals AS d FINAL ARRAY JOIN d.products_involved AS product WHERE has(d.products_involved, 'API-Gateway') AND product != 'API-Gateway' GROUP BY product ORDER BY jumlah_deal DESC LIMIT 1

question: Rata-rata jumlah produk per deal won untuk setiap segmen pelanggan.
sql: SELECT c.segment, round(avg(length(d.products_involved)), 2) AS rata_rata_produk FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY rata_rata_produk DESC

question: Cari pelanggan high-value yang punya lebih dari 2 tiket terbuka.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE has(c.tags, 'high-value') AND t.status IN ('open','in_progress') GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment HAVING jumlah_tiket > 2

question: Tag pelanggan mana yang win rate-nya di atas win rate keseluruhan?
sql: SELECT tag, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 2) AS win_rate FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id ARRAY JOIN c.tags AS tag GROUP BY tag HAVING win_rate > (SELECT round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 2) FROM deals AS d FINAL) ORDER BY win_rate DESC

question: Rekap omset per industri pelanggan per kuartal untuk tahun ini.
sql: SELECT c.attributes['industry'] AS industry, toStartOfQuarter(d.closed_date) AS kuartal, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY industry, kuartal ORDER BY industry, kuartal

question: Tampilkan pelanggan Gold di APAC yang tidak punya aktivitas sama sekali dalam 30 hari terakhir.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.attributes['tier'] = 'Gold' AND c.attributes['region'] = 'APAC' AND c.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT a.customer_id FROM activities AS a WHERE a.timestamp >= subtractDays(now(), 30))

question: Berapa median nilai deal won untuk tiap produk?
sql: SELECT product, quantile(0.5)(d.value) AS median_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL ARRAY JOIN d.products_involved AS product WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY product ORDER BY median_nilai DESC

question: Bandingkan weighted pipeline per wilayah dan tier pelanggan.
sql: SELECT c.attributes['region'] AS region, c.attributes['tier'] AS tier, sum(d.value * d.probability / 100) AS weighted_pipeline FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') GROUP BY region, tier ORDER BY weighted_pipeline DESC

question: Deal pipeline yang ada Security-Plus dan nilainya di atas rata-rata seluruh deal pipeline, tampilkan.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') AND has(d.products_involved, 'Security-Plus') AND d.value > (SELECT avg(d.value) FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation'))

question: Per tim sales, berapa persen deal won yang melibatkan lebih dari 2 produk?
sql: SELECT r.team, round(countIf(length(d.products_involved) > 2) / count(), 2) AS persen_multi_produk FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.team ORDER BY persen_multi_produk DESC

question: Rata-rata durasi aktivitas per industri dan tipe aktivitas, khusus pelanggan bertag tech.
sql: SELECT c.attributes['industry'] AS industry, a.type, round(avg(a.duration_minutes), 2) AS rata_rata_durasi FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE has(c.tags, 'tech') GROUP BY industry, a.type ORDER BY industry, a.type

question: Hitung pelanggan churn per wilayah yang pernah punya deal won dengan Analytics-Suite.
sql: SELECT c.attributes['region'] AS region, count() AS jumlah_churn FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.status = 'churned' AND c.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND has(d.products_involved, 'Analytics-Suite')) GROUP BY region ORDER BY jumlah_churn DESC

question: Siapa sales dengan omset Security-Plus tertinggi di tiap wilayah sales?
sql: SELECT x.region, x.rep_id, x.name, x.total_omset FROM (SELECT r.region AS region, r.rep_id AS rep_id, r.name AS name, sum(d.value) AS total_omset, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND has(d.products_involved, 'Security-Plus') GROUP BY r.region, r.rep_id, r.name) AS x WHERE x.rn = 1 ORDER BY x.region

question: rekap tiket urgent bulan ini per tag customer, yg tiketnya lebih dari 5 aja
sql: SELECT tag, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id ARRAY JOIN c.tags AS tag WHERE t.priority = 'urgent' AND t.created_at >= toStartOfMonth(today()) GROUP BY tag HAVING jumlah_tiket > 5 ORDER BY jumlah_tiket DESC

question: Berapa omset dari pelanggan bertag retail dengan tier Gold tahun ini, dipecah per produk?
sql: SELECT product, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL ARRAY JOIN d.products_involved AS product INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND has(c.tags, 'retail') AND c.attributes['tier'] = 'Gold' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY product ORDER BY total_omset DESC

question: Tampilkan omset tiap produk beserta persentasenya terhadap total omset semua produk.
sql: SELECT product, sum(d.value) AS total_omset, round(sum(d.value) / sum(sum(d.value)) OVER (), 2) AS persen_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL ARRAY JOIN d.products_involved AS product WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY product ORDER BY total_omset DESC

question: Untuk setiap pelanggan Enterprise, tampilkan daftar produk unik yang pernah dibeli lewat deal won.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, groupUniqArrayArray(d.products_involved) AS daftar_produk FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND c.segment = 'Enterprise' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name

question: Jumlah deal won dikelompokkan berdasarkan jumlah tag pelanggannya.
sql: SELECT length(c.tags) AS jumlah_tag, count() AS jumlah_won FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY jumlah_tag ORDER BY jumlah_tag

question: Rata-rata berapa hari deal won ditutup sejak dibuat, per produk?
sql: SELECT product, round(avg(dateDiff('day', d.created_date, d.closed_date)), 2) AS rata_rata_hari FROM deals AS d FINAL ARRAY JOIN d.products_involved AS product WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY product ORDER BY rata_rata_hari

question: Di setiap industri, produk mana yang paling banyak muncul di deal?
sql: SELECT industri_produk.industry, argMax(industri_produk.product, industri_produk.jumlah_deal) AS produk_terbanyak, max(industri_produk.jumlah_deal) AS jumlah_deal_terbanyak FROM (SELECT c.attributes['industry'] AS industry, product, count() AS jumlah_deal FROM deals AS d FINAL ARRAY JOIN d.products_involved AS product INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY industry, product) AS industri_produk GROUP BY industri_produk.industry ORDER BY industri_produk.industry

question: Rekap tiket terbuka per tier pelanggan dan prioritas.
sql: SELECT c.attributes['tier'] AS tier, t.priority, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE t.status IN ('open','in_progress') GROUP BY tier, t.priority ORDER BY tier, jumlah_tiket DESC
